content: Woun katanok-wan
Yey nases wa̱deil daGuyaws peinan, o yey aguyeimiy silma̱nin amisinap beibwein, peinan bo idaweids va̱gan bitanekes ansinap bwanabwein waseg.
Awoum kwaya̱pams, kadiloka kuma̱nums-wan, kwaptuleimiy, kusiwa̱youbs o kuvna̱ses simiyas.

Kutawtouns va̱gan bukusesus ninoumiy katanok-wan, Kululuwan Yowbad waseg, mamagina bod katanok, niwal waseg woun katanok-wan, son Kululuwan-vak katanok-wan. Bo idaweids va̱gan danamis bitaseinis katanok-wan.
DaGuyaws gog anmwa̱net, dasimounids katanok, o dakabaptays katanok-wan; Yowbad anmwa̱net, babaw ya̱kids Tamads, Takaleiwag youda babaw wasigeis, Tabunin youda babaw; e, youda babaw wasigeis nises.
Bo isiwyoubuds katanok katanok ya̱kids, mamagina Kelis ivgen isekeids.
Livan nises mamagina:

content.text: “Mitiya̱mun neimwen nein wanakaew, bo iyous antameiliws babaw, itokes inawes nakabkaleiwag waseg, mo ivgen nasiwa̱youb inagamag wasigeis.”

content: (Silawun livan towen: ‘Beimwen bein wanakaew,’ peinan wanmugwana neibus neim watinowa singay.
Mtowen neibus neim, wankuyeim mo imwen ilisow liba̱lab in-o wanakaewa singay; mo ikadilok ven babaw wasigeis, va̱gan bisesuna bikalileiwag.)

Nasiwa̱youb itam gamag wasigeis, sinap ikatipel isekes ma̱wana, mwasanin imlavags takanaweins aygan, mwasanin palopits, mwasanin takaweins livan bwanabwein, mwasanin tamtakavateins alen, mwasanin takatimlakays.
Va̱gan kid bikimtuwes tayakelesiys bitawtouns silma̱nin nawotet o bikatimweis Kelis won bitawtoun.

Mo bivag dasimounids bimlavag katanok-wan, babaw ya̱kids; nanouds katanok, bitakakina-wan Yowbad Natun; adsinaps bo bikadilok, mamagina Kelis ansinap tonen, peinan ansinap ikadiloka youda babaw wasigeis.
Kweiboug adsinaps ma̱wana gamagals, nitaliganes takatidividavs sikaleiwag kweitan kweitan mo isunasun nanouds. Nagein gog bo imatuw adsinaps.

Tut nagein adilivans mounid, siwa̱youb waseg, ikatimweis adsinaps mo imatuw, mo tanekes datoveks Kelis, mamagina kunun waseg tayakelesiys ya̱kids, o ya̱kids mamagina won tonen, antuvas babaw wasigeis, o won wuliyougwan katanok katanok ya̱kids, tamlavags woun katanok mo iwotet bwein, ikatimweis siwa̱youb waseg, mo ivakaein.
Adsinaps kweiboug o kweivaw
DaGuyaws waseg gunakaleiwag mamagina, “Awoum beivag amisinap ma̱wana tasiyas tadadubs.” Ninous makava dadub; nag ikakins mwamovan Yowbad, peinan kates keikay mo ibol ninous.
Nag ivag asimwasin wamatan Yowbad; sivines kid sinap singay kalbaleb o bikibik, bipwa̱kits waseg.
Tage Kelis nag ikatimlakeids sinap ma̱wan.
Adok towen waseg nukuliganes sinapun Yeisuw; kusimounids ansinap mounid waseg.
Mapuna towen, kadiloka kupiyaves sinap kweiboug kalbaleb; peinan vikeiyan iyagageimiy; o ikatidev ninoumiy.
E kweiboug sinap kupiyaves, kuninuways gog sinap kweivaw mo bukumlavags mamagina kweivaw gamag yakamiy; amisinap ma̱wana Yowbad ansinap mounid o didumwal.
Sinap kweivaw inakaleiwag
Kadiloka kupiyaves livan yaweid; tage bukulivans mounid wasigeis simiyas, peinan babaw ya̱kids wuliyougwan Kelis ya̱kids.
Kukin bikapasal nuwam, awoum beivag amsinap kalbaleb. Awoum biveiyov mukwavikun. Awoum kwavvikuna ee... beiboug; awoum. Awoum kutam Seitan nakaleiwag waseg.
Tavveinaw, kadiloka bipiyev sinap kalbaleb; tage naman waseg bweina biwotet beibwein mo biban inawotet anagin, va̱gan mo bivagein bisekes tasiyas tasimavs.
Awoum livan kalbaleb bisunap wawdoumiy, awoum. Misinaka livan bwanabwein bukuliva̱nes va̱gan tasiyas tanganegs bikatimweis asisinap bivakaein, mo bitawtouns, ma̱wan sivines.
Awoum bukuyagages nanon Yowbad Kululuwan Towen Bwanabwein. Mtowen waseg, Yowbad bo ilivtuwanids ya̱kids, va̱gan bitakakins igaw mo bikatinabweids.
Kupiyaves sinap kalbaleb; awoum dibamiy bimouvit; awoum bukwavikuns, awoum bikapasal nuwamiy, awoum kutawyages simiyas.
Tage kadiloka kusiwa̱youbs beibwein, bikalin nuwamiy simiyas wasigeis, igaw simiyas biyablebeimiy, kadiloka kunumlaves, peinan Yowbad, Kelis waseg, bo inumlev amisinap kalbaleb yakamiy.
